limits: Visual semantics, unnamed foundation variant meaning, geometry, contrast and source-copy overlap are not acceptance claims of this script.
Existing audit.py remains responsible for CSS scope, typography token rules and six-character copy checks.
Palette alias references in compound calculations are candidates for review; literal colours and alias definitions are definite findings.
Golden text changes are reported separately; style chart data, numeric figures and complete DOM structure are compared without general normalisation.
Missing mark/note/kick is a manual candidate because the reference non-golden examples omit those displayed parts; mandatory root/body/card structure remains strict.
A matching non-golden reference root grid is recorded as a sample-vs-README exception. Non-golden inline design and missing nested data-el remain findings even when inherited from a sample.
